title: 🩰 The Dance Studio Mystery
intro: Whiskers, Luna, Oliver, and Bella are getting ready for the big dance recital! Each one has a favorite dance style and plays their own instrument -- can you match them all up?
clues: Luna's dance is not Ballet, Tap, or Hip-Hop.
Bella does not play Piano or Violin.
hints: Clue 2 rules out three dances for Luna all at once — whatever's left over is her answer. Start there.
Clue 7 tells you Luna's instrument directly: Violin. Mark that one with confidence!
Clues 4 and 5 don't name any cat — they link an instrument to a dance. Once you know a cat's dance, check if it matches either of those clues to unlock their instrument.
Clue 3 narrows Bella down to just two instruments. Try combining it with clue 5 (Guitar → Tap) to see which one fits her.
Once Bella and Luna are settled, clue 1 and the leftovers will tell you Whiskers and Oliver — try clue 6 last to confirm Oliver's instrument.
